scope: Native SDL 3.2.18 VIDEO initialization on real Cocoa/UIKit drivers through original guest cdecl ABI, with Apple process/application main entry. Native windows, guest event conversion and game rendering are separate unfinished work.

observed.qualification: Debugger suspended the worker at an unimplemented NtQueryInformationFile probe and did not supply a return value. Ordinary concurrent startup still stops at that worker query.

contracts: Zero/EVENTS/VIDEO flags call actual native SDL initialization and teardown; audio/gamepad/sensor/camera flags remain diagnostic stops.

VIDEO requires the native main thread and a trusted Apple application entry. Cocoa initializes its own NSApplication in native SDL. The reusable native SDL_RunApp host invokes UIKit guest entry after didFinishLaunching.
All guest SDL lifecycle calls retain the established owner CPU/allocator frame and LastError/cdecl behavior; native pointers are not guest handles.

Native app exit requires guest SDL_Quit, no active guest SDL frame/subsystem and zero live mirrored allocations. It permanently closes guest SDL entry. The native host then restores original native SDL allocators and clears guest logging before UIKit post-main lifecycle work.
The host bootstrap uses native argc/argv/function pointers and is not a guest import. The guest-facing runtime remains guarded; native startup itself is a host-owned entry boundary.
dependency_fix: Persistent allocation failure exposed recursive SDL_GetErrBuf -> SDL_SetTLS -> SDL_realloc -> SDL_OutOfMemory. The pinned Apple build now uses a per-native-thread creation guard and allocation-free emergency error storage. Failed TLS installation frees the uninstalled original-allocator error buffer.

Fallback errors remain readable/clearable and successful later allocation recovers to ordinary TLS. Exact source replacements and hashes remain declared in sdl-backend.json; upstream source files are kept pristine.
validation: Mac normal/TSan/checked real Cocoa driver and sole guarded UIKit simulator app: real display id, initialization failure/retry, multiple VIDEO refs/partial/final quit, full quit/reinit, CPU/cdecl/LastError; 366/366 and 335/335 mirrored allocations/frees respectively, zero live mirrors.

Missing Apple host entry, wrong native thread, app return before SDL shutdown and guest entry after host handoff all stop; four rejected app cases on Mac and iPad. UIKit remains alive through native post-main lifecycle before the test driver terminates its own probe.

Persistent native allocator failure, 3000 concurrent per-thread error read/clear cycles, recovery and zero live custom-allocator blocks: Mac normal/TSan harness and sole simulator CLI. SDL itself remains the release library, not a sanitizer-instrumented dependency.
Existing SDL event/logging/hint/metadata/allocator regressions and external-memory compiler regression pass. Production video bridge and host entry compile for device and Simulator.
limits: No original game window, GL/Metal renderer, event union conversion, controls in gameplay, HD or authenticated multiplayer acceptance.
No physical iPad/iPhone execution; simulator app tests validate UIKit integration only.
Active native SDL worker/asynchronous callbacks without a live supported guest frame remain explicit ownership stops; post-main host ownership handoff does not permit them during gameplay.
The macOS whole-engine CLI uses process main; the whole engine is not yet linked into the UIKit application.
The next main-thread startup dependency is another runtime code patch at 0x5bb96b; the finite AOT publication guard continues rejecting it.
